purpose: Form PAS-3 is used by a company having a share capital to file a return of allotment whenever it makes any allotment of its securities.
who: A company having a share capital
when: Within thirty days of making any allotment of its securities
steps: Prepare the return of allotment in Form PAS-3.
Compile the required list of allottees and other necessary attachments as per the rules.
File the Form PAS-3 with the Registrar along with the specified fee.
checklist: Ensure the company has a share capital and has made an allotment of securities.
Prepare a list of allottees stating their names, address, occupation, and number of securities allotted to each, certified by the signatory of Form PAS-3 as complete and correct.
If securities are allotted for consideration other than cash (not being bonus shares), prepare a copy of the stamped contract or complete particulars of the contract with required stamp duty.
Obtain a report of a registered valuer in respect of valuation of the consideration, if applicable.
Obtain the valuation report of the registered valuer if shares are issued pursuant to section 62(1)(c) by a company other than a listed company.
attachments: A list of allottees stating names, address, occupation, and number of securities allotted to each, certified by the form signatory
A copy of the contract, duly stamped, pursuant to which securities have been allotted for consideration other than cash, together with any contract of sale for property/asset or contract for services
Complete particulars of the contract stamped with stamp duty where the contract is not reduced to writing
A report of a registered valuer in respect of valuation of consideration, where applicable
Valuation report of the registered valuer in case shares are issued in pursuance of section 62(1)(c) by a company other than a listed company
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
